graphSteps.about.centrality.pageRank: Scores each node by how many edges lead to it and how important their origin is. Good for “Who is central here?”.
graphSteps.about.centrality.betweenness: How often a node lies on shortest paths between others. Finds brokers and bottlenecks.
graphSteps.about.centrality.closeness: How close a node is to all others it reaches. Finds nodes from which everything is quick to reach.
graphSteps.about.centrality.eigenvector: Important is who is connected to important nodes. Like PageRank, without damping.
graphSteps.about.centrality.harmonic: Like closeness, but also works in graphs that fall into parts.
graphSteps.about.communities.louvain: Splits the graph into groups that are densely connected inside and loosely to the outside.
graphSteps.about.communities.leiden: Like Louvain, with groups that are always connected within.
graphSteps.about.communities.labelPropag: Quick groups: each node takes the most common group of its neighbours.
graphSteps.about.communities.weaklyConne: Which parts are connected at all, regardless of edge direction?
graphSteps.about.communities.stronglyCon: Parts in which every node reaches every other along the arrows.
graphSteps.about.kCore: The dense core: nodes with at least k neighbours in the core.
graphSteps.about.triangles: How many triangles a node closes and how closely its neighbours are connected to each other.
graphSteps.about.similarity.jaccard: Similar nodes by shared neighbours: customers who buy the same things.
graphSteps.about.similarity.overlap: Like Jaccard, but measured against the smaller of the two: finds subsets.
graphSteps.about.similarity.cosine: Similar nodes by their number properties, such as revenue and age.
graphSteps.about.similarity.knn: Links each node to the k most similar by its number properties.
graphSteps.about.paths.shortest: The path with the fewest edges between two nodes.
graphSteps.about.paths.allShortest: All equally short paths between two nodes, up to a maximum count.
graphSteps.about.paths.weighted: The path with the least sum of a number on the edges, such as cost or duration.
graphSteps.about.paths.kShortest: The k best paths between two nodes, the second and third best too.
graphSteps.about.reachable: What a node reaches within at most n edges, with the distance per node.
graphSteps.about.bridges: Edges without which the graph falls apart.
graphSteps.about.articulationPoints: Nodes without which the graph falls apart.
graphSteps.about.cycles: Cycles in the graph, listed up to a maximum length and count.
graphSteps.about.linkPrediction.commonNe: Suggests edges between nodes that share many neighbours. Only a suggestion, no data.
graphSteps.about.linkPrediction.adamicAd: Like common neighbours, rare neighbours count more. Only a suggestion, no data.
graphSteps.about.linkPrediction.preferen: Suggests edges between well connected nodes. Only a suggestion, no data.
graphSteps.about.mergeNodes: Turns many nodes into one per label, per value or per community, with counts and sums.
graphSteps.about.aggregateAlong: Computes over neighbours or paths: sum, mean, count along the edges.
graphSteps.where.libraryOrServer: Computes in {engine} ({library}) when the library is installed, else on the Kalzit server. Always on the query’s result, never on the whole database.
graphSteps.where.serverAlgo: Computes on the Kalzit server, on the query’s result.
graphSteps.algo.varies: The result may differ slightly between runs. The number of groups and the values stay close; single nodes at the edge may switch.
graphSteps.algo.limitAdmin: A server admin sets the limit: Settings › Data sources › Graph steps.
graphSteps.algo.label: Only nodes with the label
graphSteps.algo.fields.centrality.pageRa: Stays a graph; every node gets pagerank, summing to 1.
graphSteps.algo.fields.centrality.betwee: Stays a graph; every node gets betweenness. Costly: computes up to a fifth of the node limit.
graphSteps.algo.fields.centrality.closen: Stays a graph; every node gets closeness, 0 to 1. Costly.
graphSteps.algo.fields.centrality.eigenv: Stays a graph; every node gets eigenvector.
graphSteps.algo.fields.centrality.harmon: Stays a graph; every node gets harmonic, 0 to 1. Costly.
graphSteps.algo.fields.communities: Stays a graph; every node gets the number of its community. The number is a name, not a rank. Holds for this part of the data, not the whole database.
graphSteps.algo.fields.components: Stays a graph; every node gets the number of its component.
graphSteps.algo.fields.kCore: Stays a graph; every node gets its core number. With k only the nodes of core number k or more stay.
graphSteps.algo.fields.triangles: Stays a graph; every node gets triangles and clustering (0 to 1).
graphSteps.algo.fields.similarTable: Becomes a table: a, b, score, aId, bId.
graphSteps.algo.fields.similarEdges: Stays a graph; new edges with score link similar nodes.
graphSteps.algo.fields.linkPrediction: Stays a graph; suggested edges are dotted, are not counted and go into no later step. Topology only, no trained model.
graphSteps.algo.keepAll: Keep the rest of the graph
graphSteps.algo.sameEnds: From and To must be two different nodes.
graphSteps.algo.fields.paths: Stays a graph of the paths; every node on them gets path_order. With “Keep the rest of the graph” everything stays and the paths are listed.
graphSteps.algo.fields.reachable: Stays a graph of what was reached; every node gets distance.
graphSteps.algo.fields.bridges: Stays a graph; every edge gets bridge (yes or no).
graphSteps.algo.fields.articulationPoint: Stays a graph; every node gets articulation (yes or no).
graphSteps.algo.fields.cycles: Stays a graph; the cycles are listed, every node gets in_cycle. Cycles grow fast with length; when the maximum is reached, the sentence says so.
graphSteps.algo.mergeBy.label: Label
graphSteps.algo.loops: Keep edges within a group as a loop
graphSteps.algo.fields.mergeNodes: Changes the result: afterwards there are only the group nodes; later steps, rules and alerts use them. To expand them, turn the step off.
graphSteps.algo.fields.alongNeighbours: Stays a graph; every node with the label gets the value over the neighbours reached, each once. Only nodes in the query’s result count.
graphSteps.algo.fields.alongPaths: Stays a graph; every path gets the value over its nodes or edges.
graphSteps.algo.added.size: Rule added: size by {property}. It is listed under Style and can be changed there.
graphSteps.algo.added.groups: Rule added: color per value of {property}. It is listed under Style and can be changed there.
graphSteps.algo.added.color: Rule added: color by {property}, from light to saturated. It is listed under Style and can be changed there.
